id: Luna And The Aether - The Metanoia Album Tour-MOON, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Luna And The Aether - The Metanoia Album Tour
long_description:
Visceral, heavy and expansive, Luna and the Aether’s debut album ‘Metanoia’ is “a record that presents itself both as a musical statement and as a pilgrimage through grief, surrender, forgiveness and spiritual renewal.” - John Hastings, 13th Floor.

The project, birthed at the convergence of tenderness and turmoil, blend ethereal textures, heavy rock elements and vulnerability. Luna's dark folk essence exists at the heart of the heavy instrumentation, “moving between moments of intimacy and intensity” - John Hastings, 13th Floor.

Exploring themes of repentance, alchemy, death and forgiveness through lyricism laced in imagery of temples, healers and spirituality. Luna and the Aether bring an element of catharsis to their every performance.

See them live this spring in a city near you, to be enveloped by crushing riffs and walls of noise, and be entranced by Luna’s haunting vocals and profound lyrical craftsmanship.

‘Metanoia’ is out now on all platforms. Vinyl coming soon.
https://lunaandtheaether.bandcamp.com/album/metanoia

Friday 16th October - Ōtepoti/Dunedin - Pearl Diver
Saturday 24th October - Pōneke/Wellington - MOON
Friday 30th October - Ōtautahi/Christchurch - A Rolling Stone

id: Model - A Child Swiming EP Release Tour-Welsh Dragon Bar, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Model - A Child Swiming EP Release Tour
long_description:
Model is a beautiful mess & a trio of eye-candy from Tāmaki Makarau. Their
hyper-dysfunctional lyrics, eruptive dynamics and nervy melodies form wigged-out
tracks that feed off the crowd for an unforgettable show.

Following the release of their debut EP, A Child Swimming, through emerging local indie label T & M, Tāmaki's hardest-working government funded industry plant are embarking on a 6 date tour around Te Ika-a-Māui.

The FINAL gig of the tour finds MODEL stumbling into the Welsh Dragon... Te Whanganui-a-Tara, you have been warned! This is the one to be at, let it all hand out, hear a band at the end of their tether...
So get out on a Saturday, come listen, come watch, and SUPPORT LOCAL MUSIC!

Support from:
xD
Aotearoa Gothic EDM punk
Acerbic spoken word (that doesn't suck)
Drawled, sneered, belted or howled over the tectonic cracks between break beats, EBM and industrial rock to the landscape of crumbling domestica
Aka
Lowbrow doing highbrow doing lowbro

Jack Bromwich
Jack Bromwich is an indie-rock solo artist currently based in Pōneke, Wellington. Having
played numerous shows across the country, Bromwich’s sound evolves with every
release. Following the release of his debut EP Poser, Freak with critical acclaim from the
student radio network and local music journalists, Bromwich’s voice has started to spread
around the national music scene, taking the hearts of listeners.

id: Descendants Book Tour - Lee Hana, Ludus, Erika Grant, Junus Orca-Pyramid Club, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Descendants Book Tour - Lee Hana, Ludus, Erika Grant, Junus Orca
long_description:
Lee Hana, with friends and collaborators, is making an immersive soundworld for ‘Descendants’, his latest mind-bending collection of science fiction stories.

LEE HANA. An Aotearoa-Australian writer in Te Whanganui-a-Tara Wellington, Lee Hana’s writing has appeared in New Australian Fiction, Cordite, Dark Mountain, Overland and Antipodean SF. The story collection ‘Descendants’ was launched by PSY FI, a Pōneke showcase of future facing artists.
-
LUDUS. Intrepid electronic producer Emma Bernard is always moving between worlds: from ambient to field recordings, from Whanganui to Chengdu, from headlining festivals with her avant-industrial band BIRDPARTY, to the spiritual ambient explorations created by Ludus for diverse spaces such as Splore and O Vere Beata Lux at Erskine Chapel
-
ERIKA GRANT. Erika Grant is an outer limits sound explorer and one of Pōneke’s great musical collaborators, from Orchestra of Spheres to Cookie Brooklyn & The Crumbs
-
JUNUS ORCA. Joshua Holmes always find the human feeling in his versatile mix of electronic sounds, from noise, to ambient and dub-techno
-
DESCENDANTS. Mind-bending science fiction stories. ‘Mass hysteria overwhelms an Australian shopping mall. A Burmese monk recalls a strange path to enlightenment. A firebrand lawmaker discovers what’s left after her soul is stolen. And everywhere, in this wild panorama of the next five centuries, we find the spectral traces of ourselves. These are worlds, sometimes disturbing, where you may not recognise your descendants…’ Available now at Unity Books.

AJA LIVE AT ROGUE

AJA is an award-winning Māori artist weaving soul, R&B and te ao Māori into a sound distinctly her own.

Following the release of her debut album Kāwai, AJA has been busy on stages across Aotearoa - touring with L.A.B, performing with Fly My Pretties, and featuring on their latest album alongside some of Aotearoa’s finest musicians.

Now she brings it home to Pōneke for something a little closer.

For one intimate night at Rogue & Vagabond, AJA & friends take the stage with a live band sharing waiata from Kāwai, familiar favourites and a few special moments along the way.

Setting the tone for the night are b0iLupATmiNE & Mlkbdgr on the decks.

No big production. Just good music, good people and live waiata in the heart of Pōneke.

AJA & Friends
b0iLupATmiNE & Mlkbdgr on the decks

Rogue & Vagabond, Pōneke
Saturday 24 October

name: BVRBWYRE: All Night Long
long_description:
BVRBWYRE: ALL NIGHT LONG

One DJ for five hours. Big stamina with no rules.

The second artist to take on an all night long 5 hr set at Afters, BVRBWYRE takes over for a full-night journey through the sounds she loves most. All powered by the Third Eye Hi-Fi sound system.

Who is she?

Meet BVRBWYRE (pronounced barbwire) ?

Bass-driven, genre-bending, and impossible to stand still to. Expect playful blends of UKG, bass house, 140 dubstep, breaks and club all stitched together with sexy syncopation and a gravitational pull towards heavyweight basslines. If it makes the dancefloor move, it's fair game.

She’s cemented her reputation as a creature of pure bass energy with festival appearances including This is Living, Two Minds, CubaDupa and Mardi Gras Ohakune, plus support slots for international heavyweights Netsky, K Motionz, Window Kid, Rohaan, Enigma Dubz, and Clearcast.

Come for the groove. Stay for the bass. Leave with sore legs.

Afters @ 38 Dixon Street

Saturday 24th Oct | 10pm - 3am

18+

id: OvO (Italy) NZ Tour-Valhalla, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: OvO (Italy) NZ Tour
long_description:
For many of us, music can be like a drug. At first everything and anything feels and is beyond amazing, but over time as our consumption increases, this magical euphoria wears off to a hollow and crushing emptiness. The now discerning music addict desperately searches for that new thing that will make them feel the high that they once had. But it gets harder to again feel this way. Until they stumble across something so unique, original, and idiosyncratic they cannot help but feel giddy, childish excitement.

OvO are one of those bands. Curiously infuriating yet dangerously exhilarating in their inability to be pigeon hold into genre or specific sound. Deftly navigating between noise rock, doom, extreme and blackened metal, industrial sludge and even electronica. “Decibel Magazine” have perhaps described them best by hailing the bands sound as “a David Lynch dance party”. Italy’s OvO, continue to rewrite the definition of what alternative music can be. Something which New Zealand audiences can look forward to seeing this October 2026.


Formed by Stefania Pedretti and Bruno Dorella in Milan, Italy in the late 90s. OvO have taken their inspiration from the likes of Suicide, Swans, and Diamana Galas. Centred around the ear piercing banshee-like vocals of Stefania, and a constant guitar drone and dark menace as the undercurrent of their songs. Bruno, equally essential in their music, pounds a stripped down drum-set as if he were the leader of an invading war party. Coupled with intensive percussion samples to help craft a unique and experimental sound.


With 25 years as a band, 11 albums behind them (including their most recent Gemma), over 1000 shows/festivals across the globe, and sharing stages with many of the biggest names in experimental music; Godflesh, Lightning Bolt, Thurston Moore, Sleepytime Gorilla Music, Psychic TV, Dillinger Escape Plan, Big Brave, Ufomammut, among others - New Zealand audiences have their chance to see one of the most unique and experienced bands still active.


Sunday 25th October: Wellington - Valhalla


Tickets available from undetheradar.co.nz.

id: Sunday Jazz Ft. Alex Trask-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Sunday Jazz Ft. Alex Trask
long_description:
This Sunday presents Alex Trask!

Local saxophonist Alex Trask presents original music from his various projects, including a recent recording, his first album, and the Lighthouse Trio setlist. Inspired by folk music from around the world and infused with jazz performance practice, these tunes have a simplicity in common. Free improvised sections contrast carefully arranged melodies, allowing creativity and structure to coexist. The fiddle-esque melodies and straightforward harmonies create an open and inviting sound that changes depending on the musicians on stage. Hiding amongst these tunes will be some swing compositions and arrangements of favourite melodies.

Personnel:
Alex Trask - saxophone
Theo Thompson - guitar
Jacob Hurst - bass

Sunday Oct 25
Doors 3pm
Music 3:30pm
$15

Tickets available online and at the door!

As always, we are selling a range of refreshing drinks!

We still have our complimentary cheese crackers (we put the cheese on the crackers so you don’t have to do it) and tea and coffee, and of course...books available for purchase.

We hope to see you there! ⭐️

id: BLOOD MOON: Boyband, Cattails, Her Dead Bride-Moon, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: BLOOD MOON: Boyband, Cattails, Her Dead Bride
long_description:
BLOOD MOON: HALLOWEEN AT MOON
A thrilling pre-Halloween night of music to featuring some of the hottest bands in Wellington right now - you do not want to miss this one...

COME IN COSTUME!

The acts performing for you are:

✧ CATTAILS
Cattails bring indie-rock from the murky ponds of Te Aro. Coming off headline shows at Valhalla and Meow, Cattails are ready for a night of tunes in Newtown. Blood Moon will debut new songs of this exciting new band who have just recorded their debut single. Cattails have been described as Basketball dunking music- make of that what you will; Cattails will bring a thrilling set.
Cattails is Tyler Curtis (drums), Duncan Petre (guitar), Daniel Walters (guitar), Quentin Stark (piano), Molly Sussex (bass) and Ben Kenny (vocals).

✧ BOYBAND
A semi-chance meetup at a party, a shared love of Aunty Mena’s and a well-timed Hotel Bristol group chat. These are just a few of the things that make Boyband the most fertile band in Wellington. These Boys are extremely ready to bring their blend of pop, neo-soul, and alternative music to the stage at Blood Moon, with the goal of hitting you where it hurts, soothing you where it matters most, and getting you moving!
Boyband is Ellen Lucas (drums), Siena Mckenzie Smith (guitar), Evie White (guitar), Grace Gillanders (bass) and Millie Aislabie (vocals).

✧ HER DEAD BRIDE
Her Dead Bride is a Wellington-based band blending raw energy, distortion, and emotion, inspired by NZ Post 2000's Shoegaze, Duster, and Title Fight. Formed in 2025, the four-piece are releasing their debut single, \Phantom\ on October 23rd!

Under 18s must be accompanied by legal guardian.
